title: Scotland's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Scotland in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only caps from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Kieran Tierney: Kieran Tierney is 11th with 58, just outside.
notes.David Weir: David Weir won 69 caps but only 49 from 2000.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. All ten made their debuts after 2000, so their totals at the cut-off were checked against RSSSF (to 24 June 2026) and Wikipedia: they agree except Fletcher (81 Transfermarkt, 80 elsewhere) and Miller (68 Transfermarkt, 69 elsewhere); the RSSSF and Wikipedia figure is used and neither changes a place. Weir and Dailly, who began before 2000, are well short from 2000.
